name: Fantasia: The Realm of Thanos
source:
"Please save Fantasia!" a woman asked you.
She's in front of you, a lonely girl who does not have anyone, asking you to save an unknown world from doom by obtaining a heart key from one of four "strong boys". You decide to do the task, but......

The first one is a Demon Lord....

The second is a bloodthirsty assassin...

The third is a mysterious hooded guy...

And the fourth... has curse placed on him...

To obtain the key, there are those who will try to stop you, a shy maid, a happy-go-lucky elf, a lonely demon, and also the bearer of the ultimate key...

...Oswald Leingold.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=5258]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
“请拯救幻想世界！”一名女子向你请求。
眼前的孤独少女无依无靠，希望你从四名“强大男孩”中的一人手里取得心之钥匙，拯救一个陌生世界免遭毁灭。你决定接受任务，然而……

第一位是魔王……

第二位是嗜血的刺客……

第三位是神秘的兜帽男子……

而第四位……身负诅咒……

在夺取钥匙的路上，还会有人试图阻止你：害羞的女仆、无忧无虑的精灵、孤独的恶魔，以及终极钥匙的持有者……

……奥斯瓦尔德·莱因戈尔德。

[摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=5258]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
